definitions: Used as a filler or a discourse marker to introduce a statement, an example, or a summary.
Used to express approximation or to soften a statement.
Used to report speech or thoughts indirectly.
Used to draw attention to the speaker's words or to add emphasis.
examples: I was, like, so tired after work.
It was, like, five o'clock when they arrived.
She was like, 'I can't believe it!'
And then, like, everyone started cheering.
